name: rajesh-devkit
description: Personal dev-loop toolkit covering the SDLC from onboarding to shipped docs: skills for onboarding a project (devkit-onboard), drafting specs (devkit-specify) and recording decisions (devkit-adr); subagents for UX (devkit-ux), test-first implementation (devkit-implementer), spec review (devkit-reviewer), pre-ship preflight (devkit-ship), dependency audit (devkit-dep-audit) and documentation (devkit-docs); plus hooks that nudge an unattended session toward the next PROGRESS.md milestone, escalate sensitive ones, and run a host project's verify script after edits.
